# Dr Hamid’s Physio and Pain Clinic

Dr Hamid’s Physio and Pain Clinic in Manikonda, Hyderabad provides physiotherapy for back and neck pain, joint and sports injuries, post-surgery rehabilitation, and neurological rehabilitation.

## Clinic information

- Website: https://www.drhamidphysio.in/
- Location: Puppalguda, Manikonda, Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
- Address: 4-3/81, Opp: HDFC Bank ATM, near Friends Colony Park, Friends Colony, Puppalguda, Manikonda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500089
- Phone: +91 76010 26596
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/9AbCjEWW1ALe6uFN8
- Practitioner: Dr. Mohammed Hamid Ali is the founder and Consultant Physiotherapist at Dr Hamid’s Physio and Pain Clinic. His confirmed qualifications are BPT and MPT (Ortho), with Registration No. 0413 under the Government of Telangana.
- Clinical experience: 8+ years of clinical experience.
- Clinic established: 2021.
- Care model: founder-operated, with individualized one-to-one care.
- Listed prices: As of October 2026, consultation fee: ₹300. Physiotherapy treatment starts from ₹500; the total cost varies by treatment. Contact the clinic to confirm appointment availability and home-visit details.
- Home visits: generally targeted within an approximate 15 km radius of Manikonda; actual availability depends on the patient’s address and should be confirmed with the clinic. Priority target areas include Kokapet, Gandipet, Narsingi, Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills, Gachibowli, Financial District, HITEC City, Puppalguda, Lanco Hills, Alkapur Township, Shaikpet, Tolichowki, along with the clinic’s other existing nearby areas. This is not a claim that each location is exactly within 15 km by road.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/drhamidphysio/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61587086612280
- YouTube: https://youtube.com/@dr.hamidsphysiopainclinic
- Practo: https://www.practo.com/hyderabad/doctor/mohammed-hamid-ali-physiotherapist-1

## Full content and format notes

- Full text for eligible public pages: [llms-full.txt](https://www.drhamidphysio.in/llms-full.txt)
- AI discovery notes: [ai.txt](https://www.drhamidphysio.in/ai.txt)

- Linked Markdown copies are generated at build time from eligible prerendered canonical HTML pages. The two pages labeled “clinic-review draft” above remain linked as HTML only; their draft text is not copied into Markdown files.
- The website’s health information is general education, not an individual diagnosis or medical advice.
